games.title: Educational games
games.flagQuest: Explore the map, beat quizzes, snakes & ladders and math sprints at each station, then raise the flag.
games.snakes: 100-square snakes and ladders with quizzes: play solo, 2–4 players on one device, or online with friends via PIN and link.
games.sky: Fly the jet, collect correct answers, and shoot wrong ones. Questions follow your grade and results earn points.
games.duel: Race a classmate to answer the same questions live. Results are verified by the server and earn points.
games.train: Steer the train onto the rail with the right answer. Every correct answer adds a wagon and points.
games.crossword: 4-level crossword for every grade. Play solo or race with friends via PIN and link.
games.marketMath: Shop at the market while doing maths: totals, change, discounts and best value. Play solo or race friends via PIN and link.
games.numberGarden: Tend the garden by counting flowers, continuing number patterns and guessing letters. From kindergarten to high school.
games.exploreIndonesia: Tour Indonesia's provinces: capitals, islands, dishes, dances and traditional houses. Play solo or with friends.
games.miniLab: Run mini science experiments and predict the result: states of matter, magnets, circuits, acids and Newton's laws.
games.floorDrop: Trivia battle royale for 2–100 players. Answer right so your tile stays; the last one standing wins.

importPage.title: Import questions from CSV
importPage.intro: Upload many questions at once with the CSV template. Fill it in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice.
importPage.step1: Download the template and fill one question per row. Remove the sample rows before uploading.
importPage.step2: Save as CSV (UTF-8). Comma and semicolon separators are both supported.
importPage.step3: Upload the file. Every row is checked first; if any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
importPage.maxRows: At most {{count}} questions per file, up to 2 MB.
importPage.errorsIntro: Fix these rows and upload again:

docs.type: choice (multiple choice) or true_false. Also accepts mc / tf.
docs.grades: Target grades separated by semicolons: TK;1;2 or a range such as 4-6.
docs.subject: math, science, language, social, english or civics.
docs.games: flag-quest and/or sky-quiz separated by semicolons. Empty = every matching game.
docs.options: option_1_id … option_6_id: answer options (at least 3 for multiple choice). _en columns are optional.
docs.answer: Multiple choice: number of the correct option (1–6) or letter A–F. True/false: true/false or benar/salah.
